```{r load-packages}
library(gsm.kri)
library(gsm.core)
library(dplyr)
library(htmlwidgets)
```

```{r simulate-data}
#### Simulate Vitals Data with Duplicates ####
set.seed(42)

n_subj <- 120
n_visits <- 10
subjects <- paste0("S", sprintf("%03d", 1:n_subj))
sites <- paste0("SITE", sprintf("%02d", rep(1:12, each = 10)))

Mapped_SUBJ <- data.frame(
  subjid = subjects,
  invid = sites,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Generate VS data
vs_rows <- expand.grid(subjid = subjects, visit = 1:n_visits, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
vs_rows$vs_dt <- as.Date("2024-01-01") + (vs_rows$visit - 1) * 30
vs_rows$weight <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 75, 10), 1)
vs_rows$height <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 170, 10), 1)
vs_rows$bmi <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 25, 4), 1)
vs_rows$sysbp <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 125, 15), 0)
vs_rows$diabp <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 80, 10), 0)
vs_rows$pulse <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 72, 12), 0)
vs_rows$temp <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 36.8, 0.4), 1)
vs_rows$resp <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 16, 3), 0)

# Inject duplicates with site-specific rates
inject_duplicates <- function(values, subjects, site_map, rate = 0.10,
                              high_sites = NULL, high_rate = 0.30) {
  for (subj in unique(subjects)) {
    idx <- which(subjects == subj)
    if (length(idx) <= 1) next
    site <- site_map[subj]
    r <- if (!is.null(high_sites) && site %in% high_sites) high_rate else rate
    n_dup <- max(1, round(length(idx[-1]) * r))
    dup_pos <- sample(idx[-1], min(n_dup, length(idx[-1])))
    for (p in dup_pos) {
      prior <- idx[idx < p]
      values[p] <- values[sample(prior, 1)]
    }
  }
  values
}

site_map <- setNames(Mapped_SUBJ$invid, Mapped_SUBJ$subjid)
high_dup_sites <- c("SITE01", "SITE02", "SITE03")
clean_sites <- c("SITE10", "SITE11", "SITE12")

# Sites 1-3: high duplicate rates (25-40%) for weight; others ~10%
# Sites 10-12: very clean (2% rate)
inject_with_tiers <- function(values, subjects, site_map,
                              high_sites, high_rate, clean_sites, clean_rate = 0.02,
                              base_rate = 0.10) {
  for (subj in unique(subjects)) {
    idx <- which(subjects == subj)
    if (length(idx) <= 1) next
    site <- site_map[subj]
    r <- if (site %in% high_sites) high_rate
         else if (site %in% clean_sites) clean_rate
         else base_rate
    n_dup <- max(0, round(length(idx[-1]) * r))
    if (n_dup == 0) next
    dup_pos <- sample(idx[-1], min(n_dup, length(idx[-1])))
    for (p in dup_pos) {
      prior <- idx[idx < p]
      values[p] <- values[sample(prior, 1)]
    }
  }
  values
}

vs_rows$weight <- inject_with_tiers(vs_rows$weight, vs_rows$subjid, site_map,
                                    high_dup_sites, 0.40, clean_sites)
vs_rows$height <- inject_with_tiers(vs_rows$height, vs_rows$subjid, site_map,
                                    high_dup_sites, 0.30, clean_sites)
vs_rows$bmi <- inject_with_tiers(vs_rows$bmi, vs_rows$subjid, site_map,
                                 high_dup_sites, 0.30, clean_sites)
vs_rows$sysbp <- inject_with_tiers(vs_rows$sysbp, vs_rows$subjid, site_map,
                                   high_dup_sites, 0.35, clean_sites)
vs_rows$diabp <- inject_with_tiers(vs_rows$diabp, vs_rows$subjid, site_map,
                                   high_dup_sites, 0.25, clean_sites)
vs_rows$pulse <- inject_with_tiers(vs_rows$pulse, vs_rows$subjid, site_map,
                                   high_dup_sites, 0.30, clean_sites)
vs_rows$temp <- inject_with_tiers(vs_rows$temp, vs_rows$subjid, site_map,
                                  high_dup_sites, 0.25, clean_sites)
vs_rows$resp <- inject_with_tiers(vs_rows$resp, vs_rows$subjid, site_map,
                                  high_dup_sites, 0.30, clean_sites)

Mapped_VS <- vs_rows[, c("subjid", "vs_dt", "weight", "height", "bmi",
                          "sysbp", "diabp", "pulse", "temp", "resp")]
```

```{r compute-metrics}
#### Helper to run a duplicate-rate pipeline ####
run_duplicate_pipeline <- function(df, dfSubjects, strValueCol, strMetricID, strMetricLabel) {
  flagged <- Flag_Duplicates(
    df = df,
    strSubjectCol = "subjid",
    strDateCol = "vs_dt",
    strValueCol = strValueCol
  )
  input <- gsm.core::Input_Rate(
    dfSubjects = dfSubjects,
    dfNumerator = flagged,
    dfDenominator = flagged,
    strSubjectCol = "subjid",
    strGroupCol = "invid",
    strGroupLevel = "Site",
    strNumeratorMethod = "Sum",
    strNumeratorCol = "is_duplicate",
    strDenominatorMethod = "Count"
  )
  transformed <- gsm.core::Transform_Rate(input)
  analyzed <- gsm.core::Analyze_NormalApprox(transformed, strType = "binary")
  flagged_out <- gsm.core::Flag_NormalApprox(
    analyzed,
    vThreshold = c(2, 3),
    vFlag = c(0, 1, 2)
  )
  data.frame(
    GroupID = flagged_out$GroupID,
    GroupLevel = flagged_out$GroupLevel,
    Numerator = flagged_out$Numerator,
    Denominator = flagged_out$Denominator,
    Metric = flagged_out$Metric,
    Score = flagged_out$Score,
    Flag = flagged_out$Flag,
    MetricID = strMetricID,
    SnapshotDate = Sys.Date(),
    StudyID = "SIM001",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

#### Compute kri0016 (Duplicate Weight Rate) ####
kri0016_results <- run_duplicate_pipeline(
  Mapped_VS, Mapped_SUBJ, "weight", "Analysis_kri0016", "Duplicate Weight Record Rate"
)

#### Compute kri0017 (Duplicate Systolic BP Rate) ####
kri0017_results <- run_duplicate_pipeline(
  Mapped_VS, Mapped_SUBJ, "sysbp", "Analysis_kri0017", "Duplicate Systolic BP Record Rate"
)

# Combine results
dfReportingResults <- rbind(
  gsm.core::reportingResults[, names(kri0016_results)],
  kri0016_results,
  kri0017_results
)

# Build reportingMetrics entries
new_metrics <- data.frame(
  MetricID = c("Analysis_kri0016", "Analysis_kri0017"),
  Metric = c("Duplicate Weight Record Rate", "Duplicate Systolic BP Record Rate"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
dfReportingMetrics <- rbind(
  gsm.core::reportingMetrics[, intersect(names(gsm.core::reportingMetrics), names(new_metrics)), drop = FALSE],
  new_metrics[, intersect(names(gsm.core::reportingMetrics), names(new_metrics)), drop = FALSE]
)
```

```{r report, results='asis'}
#### Generate Record Duplication Report ####
w <- Report_RecordDuplication(
  dfMappedVS = Mapped_VS,
  dfMappedSUBJ = Mapped_SUBJ,
  vMeasuresVS = c("weight", "height", "bmi", "sysbp", "diabp", "pulse", "temp", "resp"),
  dfReportingResults = dfReportingResults,
  dfReportingMetrics = dfReportingMetrics,
  strGroupLevel = "Site"
)
w
```
